DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋の硬貨を口座へ入れるご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about depositing the coins in that bag into your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家で数えましたが、途中で分からなくなりました。書いた合計額は間違っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の硬貨合計計算が不確かなので入金前の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I counted them at home but lost track partway through. The total I wrote down may be wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a check before depositing because your own coin total is uncertain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額の確認が必要ですね。硬貨の枚数によって手数料がかかる場合があるので、先に案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the amount. A fee may apply depending on the number of coins, so let's check the guidance first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 千円札も一枚混ざっています。紙幣と硬貨を分けて出した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 混ざった千円札を示し紙幣硬貨を分ける必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's also one thousand-yen note mixed in. Should I hand in notes and coins separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the thousand-yen note mixed in and ask whether to separate notes and coins. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類が分かるように分けてください。今日は全額を入金したいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please separate them so the types are clear. Would you like to deposit the full amount today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全部ではなく、五百円硬貨二枚だけ手元に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五百円硬貨二枚を残して残りを入金したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not all of it. I'd like to keep just two five-hundred-yen coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to keep two five-hundred-yen coins and deposit the rest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その二枚を先に取り分けてください。残りについて枚数と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then set those two aside first. We'll check the number of remaining coins and the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚を取り分けました。手数料がかかるなら、金額を聞いてから入金を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚を取り分け料金を聞いてから入金可否を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've set the two aside. If there's a fee, I'll decide whether to deposit after hearing the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you've set two aside and will decide whether to deposit after hearing the fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入金を進める前に料金をご案内します。申込書の金額欄はまだ書かずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the fee before proceeding with the deposit. Please wait without filling in the amount on the application form yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額欄を空けて待ちます。数えた結果と手数料の両方を聞いてから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額欄を空けて計数結果と手数料確認後に記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the amount blank and wait. I'll fill it in after hearing both the count result and the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll leave the amount blank and fill it in after checking the count result and fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してくださりありがとうございます。料金を確認する間、こちらで少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for preparing that. Please wait here a moment while we check the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その商品の表示についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about that product's label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋は食パンですが、値引きシールには菓子パンと書いてあります。貼り間違いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食パン袋に菓子パンの値引きシールがある矛盾を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This bag is sliced bread, but the discount sticker says sweet bread. Was it put on by mistake?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the mismatch between a bag of sliced bread and a sweet-bread discount sticker. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とシールを確認しますので、まだ会計へお持ちにならず、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the product and sticker. Please wait a moment without taking it to checkout yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 購入前に気付いたので、まだ払っていません。棚には同じ袋が二つ残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未会計と同じ袋が棚に二つ残っていたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed before buying, so I haven't paid. There were two more of the same bags on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't paid and two identical bags were left on the shelf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。棚の商品も確認し、お値段だけでなく期限の表示も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. We'll check the shelf items too, and recheck the date label as well as the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋に印刷された期限は明日ですが、シールには今日とあります。どちらを見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋とシールで期限が違うと示して確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The date printed on the bag is tomorrow, but the sticker says today. Which should I go by?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that the dates on the bag and sticker differ and ask for a check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食い違っているので、確認が終わるまでこの商品はお渡ししません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: They conflict, so we won't hand this item over until we've finished checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認に時間がかかるなら、シールのない同じ食パンを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認が長引く場合はシールなしの同じ食パンを探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If checking will take time, I'd like to look for the same sliced bread without a sticker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to find the same bread without a sticker if the check takes a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 棚を調べて、表示の一致する物があるかご案内します。お急ぎでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the shelf and let you know whether any have consistent labels. Are you in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 急いでいません。表示が一致する物を見て、価格を確認してから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急がず一致した表示と価格を確認して選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I'll look at one with consistent labels and check the price before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you aren't in a hurry and will choose after checking consistent labels and the price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が済むまでお待ちください。気付いて教えてくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait until we've checked. Thank you for noticing and telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の設備で気になる所がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something about the park facilities that concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池のそばのベンチの板が一枚浮いています。座った子どもの服が引っ掛かりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池そばのベンチ板の浮きと子どもの衣服への懸念を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: One board on the bench by the pond is sticking up. It looks as if it could catch on a seated child's clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a raised bench board by the pond and concern about children's clothing catching. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を確認して点検します。池のどちら側にあるベンチですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll locate it and inspect it. Which side of the pond is the bench on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 売店から池へ向かう道の左側です。背もたれのない長いベンチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 売店から池へ向かう道の左にある背もたれなしベンチと特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the left side of the path from the shop toward the pond. It's a long bench without a backrest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the long backless bench on the left of the path from the shop to the pond. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。板を押し戻したり、座って試したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Have you pushed the board back down or sat on it to test it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 触っていません。子どもには別のベンチで待つように言いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板に触れず子どもを別ベンチで待たせたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't touched it. I told my child to wait on a different bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't touched the board and had your child wait at another bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま触らずお待ちください。職員が現場を見に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep waiting without touching it. A staff member will go and look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 点検が終わるまで、そこのベンチは使わない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 点検終了前に該当ベンチを使わない理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So we should avoid using that bench until the inspection is finished, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that the bench shouldn't be used before inspection is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認中は避けてください。点検する場所に立ち入らないよう、こちらで対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, avoid it while we're checking. We'll take care of keeping people out of the inspection area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもを連れて反対側の休憩場所へ移ります。修理の道具にも近付かないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反対側の休憩場所へ移り修理道具にも近付かせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my child to the rest area on the opposite side. I'll also tell them to stay away from the repair tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll move to the opposite rest area and keep your child away from repair tools too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 知らせていただき助かりました。お気をつけて移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please take care as you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物が大きいですね。乗り換えのホームをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That's a large bag. Are you looking for the platform for your connection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二番ホームへ行きたいです。このスーツケースを持ち上げられないので、階段以外の道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二番ホームへ向かうため重いスーツケースでも使える階段以外の経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to get to platform two. I can't lift this suitcase, so please show me a route without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a stair-free route to platform two usable with a heavy suitcase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二番ホームへは、奥のエレベーターから連絡通路を渡れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can take the elevator at the far end and cross the connecting passage to platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥というのは、売店の右側に見える扉でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 売店右側の扉が案内されたエレベーターか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: By the far end, do you mean the doors visible to the right of the shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the doors right of the shop are the elevator you were directed to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、売店の右側です。通路を渡った先にもエレベーターがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, to the right of the shop. There's another elevator at the other end of the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上がってからもう一度下りるのですね。途中で座れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上り下りの経路を確認し途中で座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I go up and then down again. Is there anywhere to sit along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the up-and-down route and ask about somewhere to sit along the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡通路にはありませんが、二番ホームのエレベーターを出たところにベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Not in the passage, but there's a bench just outside the elevator on platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチまで先に行きます。列車は二十分後なので、そこで待っていても間に合いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二十分後の列車までホームのベンチで待てるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go to the bench first. The train is in twenty minutes, so I can wait there and still make it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can wait on the platform bench for the train in twenty minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車時刻はこちらの表示どおりです。乗り場はベンチから右へ進んだ二号車の印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The departure time is as shown on this display. The boarding point is the car two marker to the right of the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二号車の印も覚えました。エレベーターを二回使って、ベンチで少し休んでから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二号車位置を覚え二回のエレベーター利用と休憩後の乗車予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the car two marker too. I'll use the elevators twice, rest a little on the bench, then board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you've noted the car two location and plan to use two elevators and rest before boarding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物の車輪が扉に挟まらないようお気をつけください。それでは、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Be careful not to let the suitcase wheels get caught in the doors. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届の記入でお困りの項目がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a section of the moving-in notification that's giving you trouble?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所の欄が一行しかありません。建物名と部屋番号まで書くと入りきらないんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所欄に建物名と部屋番号が入りきらない問題を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's only one line for the new address. It won't all fit if I include the building name and apartment number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the building name and apartment number won't fit in the address space. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの欄には番地まで書き、建物名と部屋番号は下の続きの欄に記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Write through the street number in this section, and put the building name and apartment number in the continuation section below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書では建物名がカタカナですが、その表記をそのまま写せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書のカタカナ建物名をそのまま記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building name is in katakana in the lease. Should I copy that exactly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should copy the lease's katakana building name exactly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約書を拝見すると、そのカタカナ表記で確認できます。部屋番号も書き忘れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Looking at the lease, we can confirm that katakana spelling. Don't forget the apartment number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物名と二〇三号室を下の欄に書きました。入居した日は鍵を受け取った日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物名と二〇三号室の記入を伝え入居日の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written the building name and apartment 203 in the lower section. Is the move-in date the day I received the keys?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you've entered the building name and apartment 203 and ask what move-in date means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鍵の受取日ではなく、実際に住み始めた日を伺っています。お引っ越しはいつでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We're asking when you actually started living there, rather than when you got the keys. When did you move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵は月曜日にもらいましたが、荷物を運んで寝泊まりを始めたのは水曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵を受け取った月曜日と実際に住み始めた水曜日を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I got the keys on Monday, but moved my things in and started staying overnight on Wednesday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish getting the keys on Monday from actually starting to live there on Wednesday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では水曜日の日付をご記入ください。書き終わりましたら、書類を担当窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then enter Wednesday's date. When you've finished, the relevant counter will check the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水曜日の日付を入れました。訂正した住所と一緒に、担当窓口で見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水曜日の日付を記入し訂正住所とともに担当窓口で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've entered Wednesday's date. I'll have the counter check it together with the corrected address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you've entered Wednesday's date and will have the counter check it with the corrected address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号札を持って右側の窓口へお進みください。それでは、こちらのご案内は以上です、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your numbered ticket and go to the counter on the right. That's all for the directions here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更をご希望と伺いました。現在の予約票を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you'd like to change your appointment. May I see your current appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の十時の予約です。急に勤務が入ったので、来週の月曜日へ動かしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金曜十時の予約を勤務都合で来週月曜へ変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for ten on Friday. I've unexpectedly been scheduled to work, so I'd like to move it to next Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change Friday at ten to next Monday because of work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 月曜日には空きがありますが、その日までお薬は足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an opening on Monday, but will your medicine last until then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一日一錠の薬が金曜日の分までしかありません。月曜日まで空いてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一日一錠の薬が金曜分までしかなく月曜まで不足すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only have enough of my one-tablet-a-day medicine through Friday. There'll be a gap before Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your one-tablet-a-day medicine only lasts through Friday and won't cover you until Monday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場合、単純に予約を動かす前に診療担当へ相談します。今、お薬の袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, we'll consult the clinical staff before simply moving the appointment. Do you have your medicine bag now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この袋です。薬を自分で減らすつもりはないので、飲み方も含めて確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の袋を見せ自己判断で減らさず飲み方の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is it. I don't intend to reduce it on my own, so please check how I should take it as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the medicine bag and ask for instructions without reducing your medicine yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から、今日のうちに電話で状況を確認したいと返事がありました。連絡がつく時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff have replied that they'd like to check the situation by phone today. Please tell us when you can be reached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後三時から四時なら仕事の休憩で電話に出られます。この番号へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三時から四時なら電話に出られると連絡可能時間と番号を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Between three and four in the afternoon I can answer during my work break. Please call this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your number and say you can answer between three and four. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三時から四時のご連絡希望を伝えます。今の金曜日の予約は、相談が済むまで変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your request for a call between three and four. We won't change your Friday appointment until you've had the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金曜日の予約は残したままですね。今日の電話で薬と次の受診日を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金曜予約が残ることを確認し当日の電話で薬と受診日を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: So Friday's appointment stays in place. I'll discuss the medicine and next visit date in today's call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm Friday's appointment remains and say you'll discuss medicine and your visit date in today's call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、担当からの連絡をお待ちください。本日はこのままお帰りいただけます、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please wait for the staff to contact you. You can go home now. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですが、最後に見た場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can't find your bicycle; where did you last see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅前の駐輪場の南側です。昨夜九時に置いて、今朝七時にはなくなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅前駐輪場の南側で昨夜九時から今朝七時の間に自転車がなくなったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On the south side of the bicycle parking area in front of the station. I left it at nine last night, and it was gone at seven this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the bicycle disappeared from the south side of the station parking area between nine last night and seven this morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車体の特徴や登録番号が分かるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything showing its features or registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緑の自転車で、前かごが少し曲がっています。防犯登録の控えも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 緑の車体と曲がった前かごを説明し防犯登録控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's green, with a slightly bent front basket. I've also brought the bicycle security registration copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the green bicycle and bent front basket and show the security registration copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えを確認します。駐輪場で自転車を移動したという掲示はありませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the copy. Wasn't there a notice in the parking area saying bicycles had been moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口に移動のお知らせがありましたが、日付まで読まずに来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口の移動掲示は見たが日付を未確認だったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There was a relocation notice at the entrance, but I came here without reading the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report seeing the relocation notice at the entrance but not checking its date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 盗難か移動かはまだ分かりません。管理者への連絡先を、その掲示で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't yet know whether it was stolen or moved. Can you check the manager's contact details on that notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: スマートフォンで撮った写真があります。この番号が管理者の窓口でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影した掲示の電話番号が管理者窓口か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I took a photo with my phone. Is this number for the manager's office?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the phone number in your photo of the notice is the manager's office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真には管理事務所と書かれています。まず移動先に該当する自転車があるか問い合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The photo says “management office.” First, ask whether a bicycle matching yours is at the relocation site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理事務所に色と登録番号を伝えて調べます。見つからなければ、確認結果を持ってまた相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理事務所で色と登録番号を照合し見つからなければ結果を持って再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check with the management office, giving the color and registration number. If it's not found, I'll bring the result and consult you again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the color and registration number with management and return with the result if it isn't found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをお返しします。問い合わせの結果が分かったらお知らせください、それではお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's your registration copy back. Let us know when you have the result of your inquiry. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒は、いつまでに届く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: When does this envelope need to arrive by?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募書類で、明後日の午後五時必着と書かれています。今日送れば間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募書類の明後日午後五時必着条件を伝え今日の郵送で間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's application documents, and it says they must arrive by five in the afternoon the day after tomorrow. Will they make it if I mail them today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the deadline of five p.m. the day after tomorrow and ask whether mailing today will be in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先と差し出す時刻から目安は調べられますが、期限内の到着を必ずお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check an estimate from the address and mailing time, but can't promise it will definitely arrive by the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送った日が分かる控えを付けても、必着の条件は変わらないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出日を示す控えを付けても必着条件は変わらないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if I get a record showing the mailing date, the arrival deadline still applies, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that proof of the mailing date doesn't change the must-arrive deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、差し出した記録と、相手先へ届いた日時は別です。募集案内に持参など別の提出方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the mailing record and the date and time it reaches the recipient are different. Do the application instructions give another method, such as delivery in person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内には窓口へ持参できるとあります。郵送を選ぶ前に、持参先の受付時間を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内に持参方法があると伝え郵送前に受付時間を確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They say I can take it to their counter. Before choosing mail, I'd like to check their opening hours for submissions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in-person submission is allowed and ask to check reception hours before mailing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そちらの受付時間は提出先にお尋ねください。封筒は、確認してからお出しになることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the submission destination about their hours. You can also wait until you've checked before mailing the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いったん封筒を持ち帰ります。提出先へ電話して、明日持参できるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を持ち帰り提出先へ翌日の持参可否を電話で聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take it home for now. I'll phone the destination and ask whether I can bring it in tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll take the envelope home and phone to ask about bringing it in tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日は差し出さず、お返しします。切手もまだ購入されないということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll return it without mailing it today. Is it correct that you won't buy stamps yet either?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切手も買わずにおきます。持参できなければ、送付方法をもう一度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切手購入も見送り持参不可なら送付方法を再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hold off buying stamps too. If I can't bring it in, I'll ask about shipping methods again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll postpone stamp purchase too and ask again about shipping if in-person submission isn't possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒をお返ししました。期限に間に合う方法が見つかりますように、それではお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've returned the envelope. I hope you find a way to meet the deadline. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与振込用の口座について、ご勤務先から指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did your employer specify anything about the account for salary transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この銀行で作るように言われましたが、支店まで指定されていたか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行指定は覚えているが支店指定の記憶が曖昧だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: They told me to open it at this bank, but I don't remember whether they specified a branch too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you remember the bank requirement but aren't sure about a specified branch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から受け取った案内があれば、指定内容を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have the instructions from your employer, let's look at what they specify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯に案内の写真があります。銀行名の横の手書きが支店名か、読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯の案内写真の手書きが支店名か読取りを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo on my phone. Could you read whether the handwriting beside the bank name is a branch name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to read whether the handwriting in your phone photo is a branch name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この字だけでは支店名を確実に読み取れません。勤務先に確認してから申込先を決めたほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't reliably read a branch name from this writing alone. It would be better to check with your employer before deciding where to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。別の支店で作っても給与を受け取れるとは、今は決められないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別支店で給与受取りできるか現時点では確定できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll do that. So we can't establish now whether I could receive my salary through another branch, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that salary receipt through another branch can't be established at this point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先の取扱条件を当行から確定することはできません。口座開設も、ご本人の書類確認などが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Our bank can't determine your employer's requirements. Opening an account also requires checking your identification and other documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は申込書を書かず、先に会社へ聞きます。確認するときは支店名と口座の種類でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込書の記入を保留し会社へ確認する項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't fill in the application today; I'll ask my company first. Should I check the branch name and account type?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Postpone filling in the application and ask what to confirm with your employer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 指定の支店名と口座種別、振込情報の提出期限を確認すると相談を進めやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Confirming the specified branch, account type and deadline for submitting transfer details will help us proceed with your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三点を会社に確認して、在留カードなど持っている書類と一緒にまた来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支店名と口座種別と提出期限を会社へ確認し所持書類とともに再来店すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check those three points with my company, then return with the documents I have, such as my residence card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the branch, account type and submission deadline with your employer and return with your documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認後に改めてご相談ください。本日のご案内は以上です、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult us again after checking. That's all for today. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の棚で何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something at the detergent shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本体が四百円、詰替えが三百円ですが、安いほうを選ぶ前に何回使えるか比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体と詰替えを価格だけでなく使用回数で比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bottle is 400 yen and the refill is 300, but before choosing the cheaper one I want to compare how many washes they provide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the bottle and refill by number of uses, not just price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体は四十回分、詰替えは二十回分と表示されています。標準使用量を守った場合の目安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bottle says forty uses, and the refill says twenty. That's an estimate when using the standard dose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一回分では本体が十円、詰替えが十五円になりますね。詰替えはこの持ってきたボトルに入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回分の価格を計算し持参ボトルに詰替えできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the bottle is ten yen per use, and the refill fifteen. Can the refill go into this bottle I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Calculate the per-use prices and ask whether the refill can go in your own bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちのボトルは別の製品です。詰替えの表示には同じ製品の容器に入れるよう記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bottle you brought is for another product. The refill label says to put it into a container for the same product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の洗剤が少し残っています。混ぜずに、今回は新しい本体を買うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別製品が残るボトルに混ぜず新しい本体を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a little of another detergent left in it. I won't mix them; I'll buy a new bottle this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you won't mix it in a bottle containing another product and will choose a new bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの本体が該当の商品です。香りの違うものも隣にありますが、こちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the corresponding bottle. A different fragrance is beside it; is this one okay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 香りの弱いこの本体でお願いします。四十回という数字は、毎回少なめに入れていいという意味ではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弱い香りの本体を希望し表示回数が使用量を減らす意味ではないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like this lightly scented bottle. The forty-use figure doesn't mean I can put in less every time, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the lightly scented bottle and check that the number of uses doesn't mean reducing the dose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その数字だけで量を減らさず、洗濯物の量などに対応した表示どおりに計ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't reduce the amount based on that figure alone. Measure according to the label for the amount of laundry and other factors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 量はボトルの表示で確かめます。この一本だけをかごに入れて、会計へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用量は表示で確認し本体一本をレジへ持っていくと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the dose on the bottle. I'll put just this one in my basket and take it to checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the dose on the label and take one bottle to checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計は奥のレジです。お手持ちのボトルと混同しないようお気をつけください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The checkout is at the back. Be careful not to confuse it with the bottle you brought. Thank you.
